proposals.evidence: CDIAL 7 aṃsiya explicitly gives Nepali hã̄siyo, Bengali/Hindi hã̄siyā and Bihari hãsuā sickle, as well as Kumaoni ã̄sī scythe. The selected forms preserve these y-bearing, u-bearing and h-less variants; uncertain regional transmission remains open. Exact survey form hə̃suva is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
